info.title: API.SH: UNIQLO
info.description: The UNIQLO API from API.SH: public UNIQLO data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
One UNIQLO product: name, price, promo price, rating with star breakdown and fit score, best-seller and discontinued flags, category path, descriptions, design details, composition, care and washing, size chart, countries of origin, tags, colours, sizes, images, and every colour/size SKU with its own price and stock status and quantity.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/uniqlo-product

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Crew Neck T-Shirt
example.short_description: Durable 100% cotton. Binding at the collar helps the neckline keep its shape.
example.design_detail:
- Sheer: Not Sheer
- Fit: Regular
- Pockets: No Pockets
example.washing: Machine wash cold, Do not dry clean, Tumble dry low.

get.description:
A UNIQLO product's reviews: rating, title, text, author, location, date, helpful count, fit, purchased size and colour, gender, age range, height, weight and shoe size, with the rating breakdown.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/uniqlo-reviews

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
UNIQLO product search in 20 country stores: id, name, link, price, promo price, currency, rating, review count, gender, colours, sizes, flags (sale, new, limited offer...), promotion and images by colour, with colour, size, price-band, flag and category filters and sorts. Also the colour, size, price, flag, rating and category facets.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/uniqlo-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category ids from the facets, comma separated (gender, class, category), e.g. 22211 for men.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour codes from the facets, comma separated (e.g. COL00).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size codes from the facets, comma separated (e.g. SMA004).

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: Price bands from-to, comma separated (e.g. 20-40; open ends allowed: -10, 80-).

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: Flags from the facets, comma separated (discount, limitedOffer, salesStart...).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
